description: pixel art landscape, high clay cliffs of wolin above the stormy baltic sea: pine trees leaning over the cliff edge, waves breaking on a stony beach below, the wreck of an old wooden longship half buried in the sand, small amber glints among the stones, heavy storm clouds, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, very dark muted palette of sea greys, storm blues and amber, no text, no border, no people in front, no animals in front
